```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "-")
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)
library(lavaan)

source(here::here("R", "utils_stats.R"))
source(here::here("R", "constants.R"))

data_clean    <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("data", "processed", "utbk_clean.csv"),
  col_types     = readr::cols(),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
data_nat      <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("data", "raw", "utbk_national_descriptive_statistics.csv"),
  col_types     = readr::cols(),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
history_df    <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("output", "tables", "iteration_history.csv"),
  col_types     = readr::cols(),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
mat_raw       <- readRDS(
  here::here("output", "tables", "matriks_korelasi_raw.rds")
)
mat_corr      <- readRDS(
  here::here("output", "tables", "matriks_korelasi_terkoreksi.rds")
)
cfa_fit_df    <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("output", "tables", "cfa_model_fit_comparison.csv"),
  col_types     = readr::cols(),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
cfa_load_df   <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("output", "tables", "cfa_factor_loadings.csv"),
  col_types     = readr::cols(),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
tab_sub_rank  <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("output", "tables", "tabel_ranking_subtes.csv"),
  col_types     = readr::cols(),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
tab_comp_rank <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("output", "tables", "tabel_ranking_komposit.csv"),
  col_types     = readr::cols(),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
desc_comp     <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("output", "tables", "tabel_deskriptif_komparasi.csv"),
  col_types     = readr::cols(),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

```

# Ringkasan Parameter dan Nilai Skalar Eksak (Presisi Penuh)

Berikut adalah daftar nilai eksak hasil komputasi tanpa pembulatan artifisial:

* **Ukuran Sampel ($N$)**: `r nrow(data_clean)`
* **Jumlah Peserta Hadir ($N_{\text{nasional}}$)**: `r format(N_POPULATION, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)`
* **Rerata Komposit Sampel ($\bar{Z}_{\text{sampel}}$)**: `r sprintf('%.15f', mean(data_clean$mean_8))`
* **Simpangan Baku Komposit Sampel ($s_Z$)**: `r sprintf('%.15f', sd(data_clean$mean_8))`
* **Korelasi Off-Diagonal Sampel Mentah ($\bar{r}_{\text{off}}$)**: `r sprintf('%.15f', compute_off_diagonal_mean(mat_raw))`
* **Jumlah Siklus Iterasi Hingga Konvergen ($k$)**: `r nrow(history_df)`
* **Simpangan Baku Komposit Populasi Terkalibrasi ($S_Z$)**: `r sprintf('%.15f', tail(history_df$sd_composite_out, 1))`
* **Multiplikator Restriksi Rentang ($\lambda^2 = (S_Z/s_Z)^2 - 1$)**: `r sprintf('%.15f', tail(history_df$lambda_sq, 1))`
* **Rerata Korelasi Populasi Terkoreksi Thorndike Case III ($\bar{R}_{\text{off}}$)**: `r sprintf('%.15f', tail(history_df$mean_r_corrected, 1))`

# Struktur Faktor Laten: Exploratory & Confirmatory Factor Analysis

## Indeks Kecocokan Model CFA (Robust MLM Estimator)

```{r}
cfa_fit_t <- t(as.matrix(cfa_fit_df[, -1]))
colnames(cfa_fit_t) <- paste("Model", seq_len(nrow(cfa_fit_df)))

kable(
  cfa_fit_t,
  digits  = 4,
  caption = paste0(
    "Perbandingan Goodness-of-Fit Model 1-Faktor (g) vs. Model 2-Faktor ",
    "(Literasi vs. Numerasi); Model 1 = 1-Faktor (g-General), ",
    "Model 2 = 2-Faktor (Literasi vs Numerasi)"
  )
) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"))

```

## Muatan Faktor Terstandarisasi ($\lambda$) & Komunalitas ($R^2$)

```{r}
kable(
  cfa_load_df,
  digits  = 4,
  caption = "Estimasi Muatan Faktor Terstandarisasi Model 2-Faktor Konfirmatori"
) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "striped")

```

# Korelasi Subtes ke Komposit Sampel ($r_{iZ}$)

```{r}
r_iz_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Subtes = SUBTESTS,
  `Korelasi ke Mean 8 (r_iZ)` = vapply(
    SUBTESTS,
    function(s) cor(data_clean[[s]], data_clean$mean_8),
    numeric(1)
  )
)

kable(
  r_iz_table,
  digits  = 15,
  caption = "Nilai Eksak Korelasi Tiap Subtes terhadap Komposit Rerata Sampel"
) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "striped")

```

# Tabel Statistik Deskriptif: Nasional vs Sampel

```{r}
kable(
  desc_comp[, c("subject_name", "mean_sample", "sd_sample", "median_sample",
                "min_sample", "max_sample")],
  digits  = 6,
  label   = "desc_panel_a",
  caption = "Perbandingan Parameter Univariat Nasional vs Sampel: Panel A, Statistik Sampel"
) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"))

kable(
  desc_comp[, c("subject_name", "mean_nat", "sd_nat", "min_nat", "max_nat")],
  digits  = 6,
  label   = "desc_panel_b",
  caption = "Perbandingan Parameter Univariat Nasional vs Sampel: Panel B, Parameter Nasional Tidak Resmi"
) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"))

kable(
  desc_comp[, c("subject_name", "mean_diff", "sd_diff")],
  digits  = 6,
  label   = "desc_panel_c",
  caption = "Perbandingan Parameter Univariat Nasional vs Sampel: Panel C, Selisih Sampel terhadap Nasional"
) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"))

```
